official_sources.title: GDAL coordinate-operation accuracy and fallback controls
official_sources.finding: GDAL exposes desired-accuracy filtering, ballpark rejection and only-best selection; only-best can fail when preferred grids are unavailable.
official_sources.limitation: The controls do not prove the CRS, epoch or area of interest; behavior depends on GDAL/PROJ versions.

official_sources.title: PROJ candidate-operation filters
official_sources.finding: PROJ operation creation supports ACCURACY, ALLOW_BALLPARK and ONLY_BEST, including failure when the best known operation cannot use its grids.
official_sources.limitation: Database contents, network settings and grid availability can change the candidate set unless pinned.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift semantics
official_sources.finding: Vertical grid shift uses prioritized grids; @ marks optional grids, multiplier controls sign and unit effect, and temporal use binds central and final epochs.
official_sources.limitation: Optional grids and the special epoch now reduce reproducibility.

official_sources.title: PROJ general grid shift metadata and interpolation
official_sources.finding: General grid shift requires GeoTIFF grids with explicit TYPE metadata and supports bilinear or biquadratic interpolation.
official_sources.limitation: Interpolation and metadata do not establish source-grid accuracy.

official_sources.title: PROJ pipeline step ordering and inversion
official_sources.finding: PROJ pipelines explicitly order steps and support inverse, omit-forward and omit-inverse behavior, including vertical adjustment in a separate interpolation CRS.
official_sources.limitation: A reproducible pipeline can still encode the wrong CRS, grid, axis order or vertical reference.

official_sources.title: PROJ deformation-model epoch handling
official_sources.finding: The deformation operation uses an observation epoch, a central transformation epoch and a deformation grid to propagate dynamic coordinates.
official_sources.limitation: Missing or assumed epochs can produce plausible but temporally incorrect coordinates.

official_sources.title: PROJ time-dependent transformation methods
official_sources.finding: PROJ supports 4D time-dependent transformations with rate parameters and coordinate epochs for dynamic reference frames.
official_sources.limitation: Capability does not justify inventing an epoch or CRS realization.

official_sources.title: PROJ horizontal and vertical operation ordering
official_sources.finding: Horizontal and vertical grid order depends on the geoid grid interpolation CRS; both vertical-first and horizontal-first pipelines can be valid in different contexts.
official_sources.limitation: Changing interpolation CRS or step order can change results.
